### [FX-1976](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-1976)

- Added 3 new options to `history` router
- Added a check and warning in `react-instantsearch-hooks` if Next.js is detected without the new router
- New package for the router, along with e2e tests

About the e2e tests : 

I decided to put them inside of the package itself rather than in `tests/e2e` because it's very specific. For now it's only local because I'm not sure how to approach CI with those, I don't think we should run them for any commit.
Also I edited the `next` example so I could test more but if you think it should be a separate example like `next-routing` I will do it !
